custom.message: An arbitrary Tailwind value (w-[37px], text-[11px], bg-[#0b0b0f], a min-[860px]: breakpoint): use a token's utility, or add the token to packages/ui/src/styles/tokens.css and theme.css. A custom property is written w-(--name), never w-[var(--name)]; a breakpoint is Tailwind's (md:, lg:) or a --breakpoint-* of the theme's, since a media query can't read var() (MAR-3617; DS6, MAR-3608; docs/checks/design-system-drift.md).

A colour value outside the tokens: every colour is a token in packages/ui/src/styles/tokens.css (light-dark() for both themes), worn as a utility (bg-surface, text-danger-ink) or var(--name). Code that can't read CSS takes a mirror from @convergence/ui, as xterm takes terminalTokens (MAR-3617; DS-26).

A Tailwind palette colour (text-red-500, bg-emerald-500/10): a colour is a role, not a shade (R1). A status is one of five tones, neutral, info, success, warning and danger: text-<tone>-ink, bg-<tone>-soft, border-<tone>-line, bg-<tone>-solid, or the tone prop of Badge, StatusPill, StatusDot and Notice. A named category is a hue token: merged, crew-*, provider-*, tag-* (MAR-3617; DS-1).

A dark: class in app code: fix the colour in its token instead. Each token is light-dark(LIGHT, DARK) in packages/ui/src/styles/tokens.css, so a utility is right in both themes by itself; dark: belongs inside @convergence/ui only (packages/ui/AGENTS.md; MAR-3617).

A white or black overlay (border-white/10, bg-black/20) assumes a dark surface and vanishes on a light one: use the theme-safe tokens, border-line-soft for a hairline, bg-fill-hover and bg-fill-selected for the hover and chosen fills, bg-fill-quiet for a faint panel, bg-chip for a chip (MAR-3617; DS-2).

A name only Streamdown's markup may write (bg-background, text-muted-foreground, border-border, bg-black…): theme.css's vendor bridge keeps it painting for Streamdown's bundle alone, and the app and the design system write the token: background -> canvas, foreground -> ink, muted -> surface-muted, muted-foreground -> ink-muted, border -> line (border/60 to /80 -> line-soft), sidebar -> surface-sunken, primary -> strong, primary-foreground -> on-strong, black -> viewer behind a picture or scrim behind a dialog; var(--color-muted) is var(--surface-muted) (MAR-3618; docs/checks/design-system-drift.md).

Motion by hand (duration-150, delay-75, transition-all, or in CSS an animation or transition with 600ms or ease-out typed out): durations are the motion tokens, duration-exit, duration-fast, duration-panel and duration-slow (a bare transition is already duration-fast), a transition names what moves (transition-colors, transition-opacity, transition-transform), never all, and a stylesheet writes var(--motion-pulse) and var(--motion-ease-enter) (MAR-3617; DS-33).

A focus ring typed by hand (focus-visible:outline-focus, focus-visible:ring-focus, or the old ring-ring), or cancelled (focus-visible:outline-none, which tailwind-merge lets win over a part's own ring): use focusRing, focusRingInset, focusRingField or focusRingWithin from @convergence/ui, which pick the ring by where the element sits (Button, IconButton, Input and TextLink have theirs). A field inside a box that rings for it is Input or Textarea variant="bare". Copies drift, and in Tailwind 4 most typed outline rings draw nothing (MAR-3588; MAR-3617; MAR-3618; MAR-3608; DS-7).

A focus ring that draws nothing: in Tailwind 4, outline-none sets the outline's style to none, and focus-visible:outline-2 draws in that style. Use focusRing (or a sibling) from @convergence/ui; if you must type it, add focus-visible:outline-solid (MAR-3588; MAR-3617).

A spinner built by hand: give the Button pending (with pendingLabel), or use Spinner from @convergence/ui. Both run on the motion tokens and stand still under reduced motion, and a pending Button keeps its width and sets aria-busy (MAR-3617; DS-12).
An error line built by hand: use FormError from @convergence/ui (FieldError inside a Field, DS3c), so every error reads, sits and is announced the same way (MAR-3617; DS-5, DS-13).

A native title on a button (R2): an icon-only button is an IconButton, whose label is its aria-label and its tooltip; anything else wears <Tooltip label>. The browser's title is slow, unstyled and never shows on focus (MAR-3617; DS-3).

A Button or IconButton resized in className: pick one of its sizes (R3), size="xs", "sm", "md" or "lg" (24, 28, 32 and 36 px). Each size is a height, a padding and a text size together, so a height, a min-height, a padding or a text size typed on top (size="sm" className="px-3 text-2xs") is a size the scale doesn't name and drifts from every other control: take the nearest size instead, and never resize every button in a box at once ([&_button]:min-h-10). A link has no box, so its words may take a size; a Button grown into a row (h-auto) is no-buttons-as-rows' to report (MAR-3617; MAR-3608; DS-4).

The operating system's confirm box: ask in the app with ConfirmDialog (or useConfirm) from @convergence/ui (DS3b), variant="danger" when the action destroys something, so the question looks like Convergence and the focus starts on Cancel (R5; MAR-3617; DS-6).

A raw <button>, <a>, <input>, <textarea> or <select>: use the design system's part (Button, IconButton, buttonVariants on a link, TextLink, ListRow, Input, Textarea, Select…), or say why not on the line above: // raw-element: <reason>, or {/* raw-element: <reason> */} in JSX. A raw <pre> is CodeBlock's job: tool output, a payload, a preview, scrolling inside itself with its own focus (MAR-3608; CONV-32). Scoped to apps/convergence: it names Convergence's own design system, and Backpack Studio's is Backpack (MAR-2705; MAR-3617; DS-27). A raw <label>: FieldLabel in a Field, which wires the label, the hint and the error to the control, or ChoiceField around a Switch or a Checkbox (DS-13, DS-14).

Every @convergence/ui component and motion primitive (components/<name>/<name>.tsx, motion/<name>/<name>.tsx) ships <name>.stories.tsx beside it: the stories run as tests, with an axe check, in both themes (packages/ui/AGENTS.md).

Every presentational part has <name>.stories.tsx beside it. A sub-part drawn only inside a bigger part's stories is listed in this rule's exclude instead, one line per folder (docs/checks/design-system-drift.md; MAR-3617).
A stories file's meta title starts with one of the seven groups, in the sidebar's order: Foundations, Primitives, Components, Motion, Entities, Features, Widgets (packages/ui/AGENTS.md).
Every story runs as a test with an axe check that fails it (a11y: { test: 'error' }); 'todo' or 'off' switches the accessibility gate off for the whole design system.

restrictions.message: sonner is the design system's toast engine, not the app's: raise a toast with notify from @convergence/ui (notify.failure("update Codex", error) writes R10's "Couldn’t update Codex." with the reason under it), or toast from @convergence/ui for what notify doesn't cover; the Toaster part draws it on the popup surface in R1's tones (ruling 2; MAR-3608; DS-8, DLG-31).

custom.message: An eyebrow typed by hand (uppercase with tracking-… in one class string): use SectionLabel from @convergence/ui (size="sm" for the 10 px step, as="h3" when it names a section), or sectionLabel / sectionLabelVariants({ size }) where the element can't be a SectionLabel. Copies drifted into three trackings and four weights (R0, R4; DS-20; MAR-3608).
A Badge put in capitals by className: give it caps, Badge's own prop, so every badge in capitals is one look (the third copy is a part; MAR-3608).

A Button or IconButton stretched into a row or a card (h-auto in its className, which undoes its height so more lines fit): a row is a ListRow (render a button or a link), a box that opens something is a Card with a CardAction over it, an option that needs a sentence is a ChoiceCard, and something that opens and closes in place is Collapsible's trigger. Words that act are a link Button, which has no box to undo (MAR-3608; DS-21; docs/checks/design-system-drift.md).

A native title (R2): title= on a page element, or an SVG's <title>, is the browser's hint, slow, unstyled and never shown on focus. Wrap the element in <Tooltip label> from @convergence/ui (when="truncated" for text cut short); an icon-only button is an IconButton, whose label is its tooltip. A part's title prop (EmptyState, Notice) is its words, not a hint, so only a lowercase element counts (MAR-3608; NAV-20; DS-3).

A time written by hand (Intl.DateTimeFormat, toLocaleTimeString, a Date's toLocaleString): render it with <Timestamp date={…} format="relative" | "clock" | "date" | "datetime" | "log" /> from @convergence/ui, a <time> with the whole moment in our Tooltip, or write it with formatTimestamp (and fullDateLabel, exactDateLabel) where it must be a string. One vocabulary for every time in the app (MAR-3608; CONV-22; MC-13).

A window drag region written by hand (style={{ WebkitAppRegion }}, data-app-region): the drag region has one spelling, the theme's classes, app-drag on a strip and app-no-drag on what sits on it, or ScreenHeader and DragRegion, which own the drag. Every design-system control and popup carries app-no-drag itself (NAV-11; DS-19; MAR-3608).

restrictions.message: Radix is gone: @convergence/ui is built on Base UI (MAR-3610). Use its part, or give the part a variant there (DS6; MAR-3608).
cmdk is gone: the Command Center and the pickers are @convergence/ui's Combobox and Listbox (DS6; MAR-3608).
Motion is gone (DS-33): motion is CSS on the motion tokens, through @convergence/ui's parts and primitives; a new kind of motion is a primitive in packages/ui/src/motion (DS6; MAR-3608).

custom.message: Three dots typed in words ("Loading...", "Search options...", a name cut short with + '...'): R10 writes the ellipsis character, … (U+2026), on busy labels, placeholders, cut-short text and every item that opens a dialog. Code's spread (...props, [...items]) follows a bracket, a comma or a space, never a letter or a quote, and is not reported (MAR-3608; docs/checks/design-system-drift.md).
